title: One-word answers exhaust the challenge budget
description: HAND-BUILT fixture (not a live recording; written 2026-09-11 from the engine's own replay, founder corpus gate given 4:05 PM). Seed-invariant regression (found by read-only investigation, 2026-09-11): selectChallenge (src/challenges.ts) returns null once seed.thresholds.max_challenges (3) is spent, and rules.ts row 14 is the only place that turns an exhausted budget into a terminal verdict on its own -- if a seed were ever thin enough that every challenge strategy returned null BEFORE the budget was spent, the call would stall in CHALLENGE forever instead. This is not that failure: Dana Whitfield states her identity and the full Meridian Supply request, confirms every readback normally, then answers all three challenges (each of which resolves to LIVE_COMMITMENT against her own earlier claims -- approver, amount, beneficiary) with a bare one-word non-answer ('Sure.'/'Yeah.'/'No.') that restates nothing. Every live check on file passes (SSO/OOB/context), so nothing FREEZEs; but zero challenges ever PASS, so STAGE (row 11) is unreachable and the exhausted budget falls through to ESCALATE (row 14, human callback) with no rule-failure reason to name. Proves the seed sustains a real terminal verdict once max_challenges is spent -- no call_ended action anywhere in this file, and none is needed. PATH CHANGE (2026-09-15, fragment-shaped-challenge fix, see src/challenges.ts's isAnswerShapedFor/gradeChallenges): each one-word reply ('Sure.'/'Yeah.'/'No.') is no longer answer-shaped for its field, so each of the three challenges now stays AWAITING (no knowledge_check_result card, no tally) rather than grading AMBIGUOUS immediately -- this fixture predates that fix and never re-asks the same challenge before the next one is issued (each of its three challenge_issued actions is a genuinely distinct question, one reply short of seed.thresholds.max_challenge_reasks), so none of the three ever reaches the exhausted-and-graded UNANSWERED state either. failure_tally is therefore 0, not 1.5 -- regenerated via `npm run replay -w packages/engine -- corpus/one-word-answers-exhaust-budget.json` (2026-09-15). Verdict/state/reasons/assurance are unchanged: zero challenges ever PASS either way, so STAGE stays unreachable and the call still falls through to ESCALATE (row 14).
